header: Individual reviews, stacked and undivided by columns
lead: Two to twenty rows, each with its rating, the text as submitted, and who left it. The rating is printed as a number beside its stars, because five graphics are unreadable to anyone who cannot see them.
note: The note says who collected the reviews and what you can and cannot do to them.

reviews.quote_text: The stars are drawn from the child rating field, so a half point renders as half a star instead of being rounded up to a claim nobody made.
reviews.author: The first review

reviews.quote_text: A review with no rating still renders — the star row is simply left out rather than filled with a value nobody gave.
reviews.author: The second review

reviews.quote_text: Each row is a figure: the words in a blockquote, the reviewer in the caption, and a divider between one row and the next.
reviews.author: The third review
